pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individually distinct dark-brown regions with highly irregular, serrated perimeters and sharp-angled vertices. The patches exhibit a 'leaf-like' geometry with numerous deep indentations and protrusions. Relative spatial area of patches significantly exceeds that of the separating corridors.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous lattice of light-cream pathways forming a complex topological web. Junction nodes typically display trivalent or tetravalent intersections. Pathway width is relatively uniform, though it narrows at the acute vertices of the surrounding dark patches.
